english_draft: Samsung Electronics reported Q3 2025 consolidated revenue of KRW 86.1tn, up 15.4% QoQ, and operating profit of KRW 12.2tn. Device Solutions sales rose 19% QoQ. Memory hit a quarterly sales record, led by HBM3E and server SSDs. This analysis uses only the official IR release; no same-period preview exists. Segment profit, guidance, and cash flow were not provided, so remain unchecked. Editorial review pending.
